## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. Mention any relevant checks you could not run.
For visible changes, include phone/desktop screenshots or native device evidence and note keyboard/accessibility checks.

## Context for the reviewer

Include anything needed to assess the change. For data-source additions, link the official documentation and describe units, source periods, reuse terms and request limits. Omit this section if it is not needed.
